title: 07. Oops, I Forgot!
reviewMethod: English read-aloud translation compared with every original Korean page

pages.text: Toto loved preschool so much! Every morning, Toto barely stopped to put on shoes before bursting through the door. Hurry, hurry! I want to play! Those long ears fluttered in the wind.
Toto wanted to play so badly that handwashing was forgotten. Hurry, hurry! Toto rushed right past the sink toward the toys. Hori called, Toto, your hands! But Toto was already far away.
Toto forgot to put the backpack in the cubby, too, and tossed it on the floor before rushing off again. The water bottle rolled away. Hurry, hurry! I'll do it later! Things lay scattered behind Toto.
At outdoor playtime, Toto bounded down the steps two at a time. Hurry, hurry! I'm first! Bori called from behind, Slow down, Toto! But Toto didn't stop.
Then, whoops! Toto's foot slipped. Thump! Toto fell and tumbled, scraping a knee. Ouch! It hurts! Tears streamed from Toto's eyes.
Teacher Sheep hurried over. Gently blowing on the sore knee, the teacher put on a bandage. That gave you a fright, didn't it? You're okay now. The friends gathered around, looking worried.

When the knee felt a little better, Teacher Sheep spread out a big sheet of paper. What can we do to keep everyone safe in the Rainbow Class? Shall we decide together? The friends sat in a circle with bright eyes.

Everyone had an idea. Bori said, Walk slowly on the stairs. Hori said, Wash our hands. Kongi said, Put our backpacks in our cubbies! They drew pictures of each idea. Toto picked up a crayon. I want to draw, too!

On the finished Rainbow Class Promises sheet, everyone made a handprint. Toto dipped a little hand in paint and pressed it down. Let's all keep our promises! The colorful handprints looked as lovely as a rainbow.

The next morning, Toto was different. Hands were washed, the backpack went in the cubby, and the stairs were taken one step at a time. Slowly, one thing at a time! Toto smiled at the promises on the wall. A fun day won't run away just because you take your time.
